mine_news.headline: Austin Reaves: Will play Friday
mine_news.body: Reaves (heel) is available for Friday's game against San Antonio, NBA reporter Marc Stein reports.

mine_news.headline: Lakers' Austin Reaves available vs. Spurs after missing 5 games with heel bruise
mine_news.body: Lakers guard Austin Reaves is available to play in Friday night's NBA Cup matchup against the Spurs after missing the last five games with a heel bruise.

mine_news.body: Los Angeles Lakers vs. San Antonio Spurs: Game Highlights

mine_news.headline: Darius Garland: Scores 19 points Friday
mine_news.body: Garland posted 19 points (7-15 FG, 3-7 3Pt, 2-2 FT), three rebounds, nine assists and a steal across 32 minutes in Friday's 105-104 loss to the Pelicans.

mine_news.headline: Victor Wembanyama: Posts double-double Saturday
mine_news.body: Wembanyama posted 25 points (10-25 FG, 2-5 3Pt, 3-8 FT), 16 rebounds, two assists, four steals and two blocks across 35 minutes in Friday's 99-96 win over the Lakers.

mine_news.headline: Ty Jerome: Tallies 18 points in win
mine_news.body: Jerome logged 18 points (7-18 FG, 2-6 3Pt, 2-2 FT), one rebound and three assists over 27 minutes during Friday's 114-109 victory over Minnesota.

mine_news.headline: Austin Reaves: Strong numbers in return to lineup
mine_news.body: Reaves finished with 21 points (8-15 FG, 5-9 3Pt), eight rebounds and one assist across 36 minutes during Friday's 99-96 loss to the Spurs.
